source_questions:
What is the first means of transportation the vloggers take when they come to China?
(A) High-speed train
(B) Train
(C) Plane
(D) Subway

How does the vloggers leave the platform and go upstairs?
(A) After they get off the high-speed train, they go pass the ticket gate, exiting the train station
(B) After they get off the high-speed train, they take the escalator and go pass the ticket gate, exiting the train station
(C) After they get off the high-speed train, they take the escalator, go upstairs and go pass the ticket gate, exiting the train station
(D) After they get off the high-speed train, they go upstairs and go pass the ticket gate, exiting the train station
source_answers: D: After they get off the high-speed train, they go upstairs and go pass the ticket gate, exiting the train station
